decisions.statement: A string with no separator is a name rather than a path naming a folder.
A string equal to a folder names that folder.
A string carrying on from a folder at a separator names that folder.
A string opening with a folder's letters but not at a separator names no folder.
The first folder named of the folders handed in is the folder answered.
A string naming a folder that moved lands under the folder that folder moved to.
What the string spells after that folder is kept as the string spells it.
A string naming no folder that moved lands nowhere.
Where a string lands is read through what names the folder rather than beside it.
Nothing here reads the disk or the index.
Nothing here reads a body or rewrites one.
Whether a folder is there is not judged here.

definition: a path-shaped string read against a folder
